h: Children of the Palace Can Reach the Light of Torah

p: "Children of the palace who long, etc."
At all the meals of Shabbos
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב רנב, ב)
as is written in the holy Zohar (II 252b):
there are set in order there
all the tables of the people of the world
who are called children of the King's palace, etc."
And all the meals of Shabbos
are called "the meal of the King,"
for they eat from the King's meal.
So why specifically at this meal
do we say "children of the palace, etc."?
(פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ, זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג רכ, א)
and an alef-beis of small letters;
are of the World to Come,
That is, Yud alludes to Chochmah;
the letter Yud of the Name Havayah
and the letter Yud of the Name Adnus
And this is what it says in the holy Zohar
the upper Yud of Havayah, etc.,
which He cut for him, etc.,
and it is the holy sign, etc.,
and this is inscribed constantly, forever;
it is the sign of Shabbos,
the sign of the Yamim Tovim, etc."
הוּא רַק בְּשַׁעַת שֶׁהוּא לָבוּשׁ בָּהֶם
is only while he is wearing them
but the sign of the covenant is constant;
and this is why it says
And likewise the sign of Shabbasos and Yamim Tovim,
since he rests from work the whole day,
"If he sat and did not commit a sin,
he is given reward as one who performs a mitzvah";
and this is called "it came to his hand,"
since he is accustomed to work
through the power of the mitzvah,
And this is what it says in the holy Zohar (ibid., III 238a):
"that they are the children of the Matronisa,
is called in the holy Zohar "Matronisa,"
and Adnus has the numerical value of "heichal,"
"And Hashem is in His holy Sanctuary";
is called the Sanctuary of Hashem.
And this is "children of the Matronisa,
for they are children of the supreme King,
and as it has been said:
בָּנִים אַתֶּם לַה׳ אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְכוּלֵּי (דְּבָרִים יד, א)
'You are children of Hashem your God, etc.'" (Devarim 14:1).
is the aspect of the Name Havayah,
regarding the blessing of the Torah before it:
'When I call the Name of Hashem,
and then they are called children of Hashem.
And it is as is written in the Ra'aya Mehemna
"Vav and Hei: the Torah and the mitzvah,
which is the attribute of Tiferes,
and the Hei, which is the attribute of Malchus,
הוּא עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בַּגְּמָרָא (סוֹטָה כא, א)
This is based on what is written in the Gemara (Sotah 21a):
"The verse compared the mitzvah to a lamp:
just as a lamp gives light
it is found that "the lamp is a mitzvah" (Mishlei 6:23)
meaning a lamp and wick without a flame,
which gives no light at all;
by which the lamp is lit;
that both these and those are the words of the living God:
when one performs a mitzvah not for its own sake,
or a plain mitzvah without intent,
like a commandment of men learned by rote,
it is a lamp without light,
and of this the holy Zohar speaks;
but when he performs the mitzvah for its own sake,
then there is light in the mitzvah too,
is only the two hundred and forty-eight positive commandments;
and of this the Gemara cited above speaks.
that the light in the mitzvah, of all the mitzvos,
that gives light for a time;
which is not so of the "Torah is light"
which is a light that shines forever.

p: And concerning Shabbos it is found
(at the beginning of Seder Eliyahu Rabbah):
אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁאַתֶּם עוֹשִׂים מְלָאכָה
let Shabbos be made entirely Torah.
a person should rise early and learn on Shabbos."
And in the Pesikta they said
only to occupy oneself with Torah"
who are busy with their affairs
during the six days of work.
and they are children of the supreme King"
"You are children of Hashem your God"
through the power of "Torah is light."
And the mitzvah of delighting in Shabbos
that even when one eats on Shabbos
for the pleasure of the body,
the eating is nonetheless in holiness
בִּלְשׁוֹן הַמְעַנֵּג אֶת הַשַּׁבָּת (שַׁבָּת קיח, ב)
in the wording "one who delights the Shabbos" (Shabbos 118b),
for to bring light from the mitzvah
one must intend it for the sake of Heaven,
and then there will shine in the mitzvah
we do not mention "children of the palace";
a Jew merits the light of Torah,
and they are children of the supreme King
and "at night light will reach it."
שֶׁהוּא כְּנֶגֶד קְדוּשַּׁת יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
which corresponds to the holiness of Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
שֶׁאַף מִי שֶׁלֹּא זָכָה לְאוֹר תּוֹרָה
that even one who did not merit the light of Torah
"an inheritance of the congregation of Yaakov";
and they said in the Midrash (Vayikra Rabbah 9:3):
'an inheritance of the congregation of Yaakov'
'the congregation of Yannai' is not written here,
has a share in the Torah,
for so it is expounded (Bava Metzia 33b):
"'and to the house of Yaakov their sins' (Yeshayahu 58:1)
And for this we ask on Shabbos:
"and grant our portion in Your Torah";
has a share in the Torah.
And about this we say at this meal
that even one who did not merit
to be "inscribed with the upper letter Yud"
to be "children of the supreme King,"
which is "the lamp is a mitzvah,"
they are "inscribed with the lower letter Yud"
and they are "children of the Matronisa,"
as is written in the holy Zohar.
And we say "children of the palace who long,"
עַל יְדֵי הַחֵשֶׁק שֶׁיֵּשׁ לָהֶם בַּלֵּב
through the yearning they have in the heart
"to see the radiance of Ze'ir Anpin,"
which is the letter of truth
as we said from the Gemara;
"to see the radiance of Ze'ir Anpin."
